items.title: Edward "Noon" Johnson Interview, 1960-05-28
items.q: Kepard had my horn and he left that old broken horn at his house and he went off and played somewhere

ctx.x: Yeah. Haven't you got another two but now, Noon, you've got another one. Noon, you've got another two behind you now. Didn't I see you with another one a few weeks ago? Silver colored one with a hole in it or something and something falling off?
I couldn't get to, Kepard had my horn and he left that old broken horn at his house and he went off and played somewhere and I had to go play, I had to have some kind of.
